data.command: $tag='aiw-say-fd036-r3-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); $testExe=Join-Path $env:TEMP ($tag+'.exe'); $env:GOCACHE=Join-Path $env:TEMP ($tag+'-cache'); $env:GOPROXY='off'; $env:GOSUMDB='off'; $env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'; go build -o $testExe ./cmd/aiw-say; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'go build failed' }; $env:AIW_SAY_BIN=$testExe; python -B -m unittest -v tests.test_fd036_say_blackbox
data.scope: Compile cmd/aiw-say to a random TEMP executable and run only tests.test_fd036_say_blackbox, including the TOML table-header comment regression, against its local loopback mock.
data.side_effects: Unique random TEMP executable and isolated Go build cache remain; Python temporary directories self-clean and bytecode is disabled; GOPROXY and GOSUMDB disable network downloads/checks. No repository/user configuration writes, external API calls, credentials, or privilege changes.
data.risk_review: Inspected the standard-library mock HTTP server, temporary config and subprocess isolation. The new table-header regression verifies settings apply. The command is offline, focused, and confined to one test module plus temporary files.
